mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the past month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.0%), an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, suppressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.0% periods, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC for the regime-conditional signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100) over the past month indicates manufacturing sector contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter indicate a deepening economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that dampens economic growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
